Strategy
The Fund mainly invests its assets into various types of exchange traded index funds (ETFs) which invest their assets in both fixed income and stock markets. The Fund pursues a systematic rebalanced coresatellite investment strategy in which the core investments consist of passive exchange traded market value weighed funds (ETF) and the satellite investments consisting of non-market-value weighed investment targets.The share of stock-based investments in the Fund’s basket may vary between 30 and 70 percent. In a neutral market situation, the share of stock-based investments is 50 %. The Fund’s investments are diversified effectively both geographically and between various asset classes.
